title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 18: the proverb about sour grapes, the just man and the wicked man, and the call to make a new heart.

questions.text: What proverb were they using concerning the land of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks about the proverb, 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge,' and says it shall no longer be used.

answers.text: The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge
As is the mother, so is her daughter, and as the father, so his son
The days are prolonged, and every vision in Israel fails
The children have eaten sour grapes, and the fathers' teeth are set on edge

questions.text: According to verse 4, who shall die?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says all souls are his, and that the soul who sins, he shall die.

answers.text: The son of the sinner
The father of the wicked man
The soul who sins
Everyone in the land alike

questions.text: What does the just man do for the hungry?
questions.explanation: Among the things said of the just man, he has given his bread to the hungry and has covered the naked with a garment.

answers.text: He sells them grain at a fair price
He gives them his bread
He lends them money at interest
He sends them to the priests

questions.text: What has the just man not done with his money?
questions.explanation: He has not lent with interest, has not taken any increase, and has withdrawn his hand from iniquity.

answers.text: He has not buried it in the field
He has not paid tribute with it
He has not given it to the temple
He has not lent at interest or taken increase

questions.text: What happens to the son who robs, lends with interest and commits these abominations?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks whether such a son shall live, and answers that he shall not live but shall surely die, and his blood will be on him.

answers.text: He shall surely die, and his blood will be on him
He shall live for his father's sake
He will be driven out of the land
He will bear his father's iniquity

questions.text: What is said about the son who sees his father's sins and does not do the same?
questions.explanation: Such a son shall not die for the iniquity of his father; he shall surely live.

answers.text: He bears half his father's iniquity
He shall not die for his father's iniquity
He dies together with his father
He must first bring an offering

questions.text: What does verse 20 say about the father and the son bearing iniquity?
questions.explanation: The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son.

answers.text: The son bears his father's iniquity
The father bears his son's iniquity
Neither one bears the other's iniquity
Both bear it together

questions.text: What happens to the transgressions of a wicked man who turns from all his sins?
questions.explanation: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him; in his righteousness he shall live.

answers.text: They are counted against him double
They are borne by his children
They remain until the day he dies
None of them will be remembered against him

questions.text: What does Yahweh say about the death of the wicked?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks whether he has any pleasure in the death of the wicked, and would rather that he return from his way and live.

answers.text: It pleases him, because it is his justice
He has no pleasure in it and would rather he return and live
It is hidden from his eyes and forgotten
His statutes require it of the wicked

questions.text: What were they told to make for themselves?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'Cast away from you all your transgressions, and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit.'

answers.text: A new heart and a new spirit
A new covenant with Yahweh
A new altar of stones
A new king over Israel
